name: Original Lamb & Rice
labelNotes: For dogs over 35 kg the label says to add 100 g per 10 kg of body weight; HungryDog follows that up to 80 kg.
Pregnant or nursing dogs may need food available at all times. Keep fresh water available at all times.

source.notes: Owner's bag (Australia), 'ORIGINAL Daily feeding guide ADULT' photo; the maker's AU Lamb & Rice page shows the identical table. Bands stored as rows at their ends (they join exactly): 5-10 kg 70-110 g, 10-15 kg 110-150 g, 15-25 kg 150-250 g, 25-35 kg 250-350 g. 'Up to 5kg: 20-70 g' gives no weight for 20 g, so only 5 kg = 70 g is stored (below 5 kg the app uses calories). '35kg+: Add 100g per 10kg of body weight' continues the 25-35 kg slope, so rows 50-80 kg follow it (500-800 g). Energy: maker's page, ME 3,770 kcal/kg = 377.0 kcal/100 g. Phosphorus: maker's guaranteed analysis 'P (max) 1.4%', read as fed (moisture max 10%). Label amounts sit at about 66-82% of a 1.6 x RER estimate from 5 to 35 kg: that is what the label and the maker print. Sizes 3, 10, 20 kg. AAFCO adult maintenance, all breed sizes.
